entry.name: MAV_CMD_NAV_LOITER_TIME_MIN
entry.description: Loiter around this waypoint for X minutes, at a specified radius. Identical to MAV_CMD_NAV_LOITER_TIME except that the loiter duration is expressed in minutes rather than seconds, which frees enough mission storage to carry a per-command radius. Duration is stored with one minute of resolution.
entry.param: Radius around waypoint. If positive loiter clockwise, else counter-clockwise. 0 means use the vehicle default loiter radius. Radii above 255m are stored with 10m of resolution.
Forward moving aircraft this sets exit xtrack location: 0 for center of loiter wp, 1 for exit location.

enum.name: SWARM_VEHICLE_STATE
enum.description: Status of what an individual swarm vehicle is doing.

entry.name: SWARM_VEHICLE_STATE_UNKNOWN
entry.description: Unknown.

entry.name: SWARM_VEHICLE_STATE_INGRESSING_TO_MESH
entry.description: Currently traveling to join the mesh network.

entry.name: SWARM_VEHICLE_STATE_LOST_COMMS
entry.description: Have lost contact with the mesh and unable to sync and unable to provide service.

entry.name: SWARM_VEHICLE_STATE_ON_STATION
entry.description: Situation NORMAL, on station providing service

entry.name: SWARM_VEHICLE_STATE_ON_STATION_BUT_REQUESTION_RTB_SOON
entry.description: On station providing service but requesting Return to Base soon, will need to leave the on station point within 30min. This allows time for an additional vehicle to join the swarm to take it's place without a gap in coverage. Next expected state is ON_STATION_BUT_REQUESTION_RTB_NOW.

entry.name: SWARM_VEHICLE_STATE_ON_STATION_BUT_REQUESTION_RTB_NOW
entry.description: On station providing service but will be switching to Return to Base in less than 2 minutes. Next expected state is EGRESSING_MESH_RTB.

entry.name: SWARM_VEHICLE_STATE_WAS_ON_STATION_BUT_RELOCATING
entry.description: Was recently on station but mesh topography has changed and are currently in transit to new on station point.

entry.name: SWARM_VEHICLE_STATE_EGRESSING_MESH_RTB
entry.description: Leaving mesh to return to base. Is still acting as mesh node providing service on the way back.

entry.name: SWARM_VEHICLE_STATE_RTB
entry.description: Returning to base. May or may-not be providing service on the way back.

entry.name: SWARM_VEHICLE_STATE_READY_TO_JOIN_MESH
entry.description: Not providing service but is able and ready to join.

entry.name: SWARM_VEHICLE_STATE_NOT_READY
entry.description: Not ready, not providing service. For air vehicles this means we're powered up on the ground and likely performing ground checks. Next expected state is likely READY_TO_JOIN_MESH.

enum.name: SWARM_ROI_STATUS
enum.description: Status of the ROI from the swarm vehicle's perspective.

entry.name: SWARM_ROI_STATUS_NEEDS_UPDATE
entry.description: Has a valid ROI but it's old. We've seen another CRC with a newer timestamp.

entry.name: SWARM_ROI_STATUS_OK
entry.description: Has a valid and up-to-date ROI.

enum.name: SWARM_COVERAGE_STATUS
enum.description: Status of mesh network coverage. Ideally the whole swarm should be generating the same status.

entry.name: SWARM_COVERAGE_STATUS_ROI_IS_NOT_READY
entry.description: ROI is not ready so a coverage status is unable to be determined.

entry.name: SWARM_COVERAGE_STATUS_NOT_ENOUGH_VEHICLES
entry.description: Swarm mesh has insufficient vehicle resources to cover the ROI.

entry.name: SWARM_COVERAGE_STATUS_MINIMUM
entry.description: Swarm mesh currently has the minimum resources to cover the ROI. However, network is expected to have breif gaps in service coverage.

entry.name: SWARM_COVERAGE_STATUS_QOS_GOOD
entry.description: Swarm mesh currently has enough vehicle resources to cover the ROI sufficiently to satisfy Quality of Service requirement.

entry.name: SWARM_COVERAGE_STATUS_QOS_VERY_GOOD
entry.description: Swarm mesh currently has enough vehicle resources to cover the ROI sufficiently to satisfy MORE than the Quality of Service requirement to better handle unexpected loss of mesh node(s).

message.name: SWARM_VEHICLE
message.description: Position of an aircraft in swarm.
message.field: UTC timestamp of when this packet was generated. Seconds since 1970, or 0 if not available.
Effective Radius of radio distance. Includes loiter radius and any overlap margin.

message.name: SWARM_VEHICLE_SLOW
message.description: Position of an aircraft in swarm with data that updates less often.
message.field: UTC timestamp of when this packet was generated. Seconds since 1970, or 0 if not available.
Effective Radius of radio distance. Includes loiter radius and any overlap margin.

Region-of-Interest 32bit CRC. Zero indicates unknown. If a valid CRC computes to zero, use 1. This CRC is used to verify an ROI that is actively loaded. It is used to keep the swarm in sync without having to constantly send it to the mesh to verify.
UTC timestamp of ROI generation. Seconds since 1970, or 0 if not available.

message.name: SWARM_VEHICLE_ROI
message.description: Region of Interest points. Array of int32_t lat/lng pairs of polygon points.
message.field: Aircraft ID of intended target. Use 0 for broadcast.
32bit CRC of ROI of the complete polygon.
UTC timestamp of ROI generation. Seconds since 1970, or 0 if not available.
Number of points in the ROI polygon. One point is considered an int32 pair. This value must be >= 3 to be a valid polygon.
Latitude and Longitude int32 pairs. One polygon point is two of these enteries. Even indexed values are latitude, odd are longitude.

message.name: AIRSPEEDS
message.field: Vehicle airspeed 1 speed in form appropriate for vehicle type. For standard aircraft this is typically calibrated airspeed (CAS) or indicated airspeed (IAS) - either of which can be used by a pilot to estimate stall speed.

Vehicle airspeed 2 speed in form appropriate for vehicle type. For standard aircraft this is typically calibrated airspeed (CAS) or indicated airspeed (IAS) - either of which can be used by a pilot to estimate stall speed.

message.name: LOG_THIS_STRING
message.description: Non-functional message from the GCS for the vehicle to log locally
message.field: If non-zero, also echo this string to all mavlink ports as a STATUSTEXT.

message.name: ALT_SRC
message.description: Active altitude measurement source of the primary EKF3 core. Sent by the vehicle to the GCS.
message.field: 0=None, 1=Barometer, 2=Rangefinder, 3=GPS, 4=Beacon, 6=ExternalNav, 255=Unknown or unavailable (including when EKF3 is not active).
